description: Render an overlay transparently and composite it onto one local video (up to 60 seconds) at start_seconds. Automatically selects and reauthorizes the nearest supported aspect, returned as aspect. The start must fit the overlay within the video. Returns job_id; poll job_status. Produces H.264/AAC MP4 with audio, source aspect, long side capped at 1920. Local media never uploads. Use edit_video for longer or multi-clip edits.

configuration.description: The relative configuration URL returned by configure_overlay.

name: add_overlay_to_video
